description: Past-hours weather observations (NWS station) — Actual observed weather for the last 1-72 hours at the nearest US National Weather Service station: hourly temperature, dew point, humidity, wind and gusts, pressure, visibility, precipitation, plus a summary (high/low, max gust, precip total, pressure trend). Pass lat/lon or place. Public domain. JSON. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).

place.description: alternative to lat/lon, e.g. Nashville, TN

name: weather_observations
